instructionBm.title: How to get ID
instructionBm.step2a: Select the Business Portfolio to be used for Tentaklik Ads account later.
instructionBm.step3a: Enter the authentication code first (make sure you have registered 2FA).
instructionBm.step4a: Select Business Portfolio Info on the left menu.
instructionBm.step5a: Business Manager ID is located under your Business Portfolio name.
instructionBm.step1b: Go to the tiktok ads business center page at
instructionBm.step3b: Select the Business Center Portfolio to be used for Tentaklik Ads account later.
instructionBm.step4b: Business Center (BC) ID is located in the Account Overview section.
